hook: Push (押) and come close (寄せる): a crowd pushes forward and rushes toward you.
Polite (御) worldly (世) words (辞): sweet social talk you don't really mean, flattery.
襲 has a dragon (龍) over clothing (衣): a dragon jumps on you and attacks.
Late (遅く) + even if (とも): even if it is late, no later than this, at the latest.
Fear (恐れ) comes in (入る): you feel so small and grateful you are almost afraid.
Fall (落ち) and arrive (着き): everything has settled down, so you are calm.
Fallen (落) leaves (葉): the leaves that drop in autumn.
使 means use or send: you are sent out to do a small job, an errand.
Hands (手) up (上げ): you raise your hands and give up.
脅 has three powers (力) over a body (月): strength used to scare someone, threaten.
Old clothes (衰 looks like 衣) wearing thin in the middle: getting weaker, declining.
Same (同い) year (年): someone born in the same year as you.
From itself (自): it happens by itself, naturally.
Heart (忄) + go away (去): your heart wants to run away, you are frightened.
Same 脅 as 脅す (threaten): to threaten someone's safety or position.
Bag (袋): the bag that carried you as a baby, a casual word for your mom.
宮 means shrine or palace: お宮 is a Shinto shrine.
Run (走) toward a place: to go or proceed somewhere.
Heavy (重): treat something as heavy and important, so you respect it.
Heavy (重) in your mind: give it weight, value it. An older form of 重んじる.
及 means reach: the list reaches one more thing, and, as well as.
Wood (木) + watch over (監): a wooden box where animals are watched, a cage.
Fold (折り) + return (返す): fold the edge back, or turn back the way you came.
Woven (織) thing (物): textile, fabric.
愚 is a monkey (禺) over a heart (心): a monkey's mind, foolish.
Warm (温) + peace (和): a warm, peaceful nature, gentle and mild.
Change (改) for the bad (悪): a change that makes things worse.
Sea (海) + carry (運): carrying goods by sea.
Outside (外) money (貨): foreign money.
Shellfish (貝) + hard husk (殻): the hard shell of a sea animal.
Outside (外) view (観): how something looks from the outside.
Floor or step (階) + rank (級): steps of rank, a social class.
Sea (海) + narrow gorge (峡): a narrow strip of sea between two lands, a channel.
Change (改) + repair (修): fix and improve a building or road.
Strange (怪) beast (獣): a monster like Godzilla.
Untie (解) + remove (除): take away a rule or an alarm, cancel it.
Outside (外) minister (相): the minister for foreign affairs.
Harm (害) + する: to do harm, to hurt or offend.
General (概) explanation (説): an outline of a topic.
Turn around (回) + send (送): send something on, or a bus going back empty.
Floor (階) + layer (層): the layers of society, a hierarchy.
Change (改) what is fixed (定): revise prices or rules.
Change (改) + correct (訂): revise the text of a book.
Town (街) + road (道): an old highway linking towns.
The said thing (該) hits (当) the target: it fits the condition, it applies.
Town street (街) + head (頭): at the head of the street, out on the street.
Go between (介) + enter (入): step in between, intervene.
General (概) thought (念): a concept.
Sea (海) + pull out (抜): how far the land rises out of the sea.
Help (介) + hold in your arms (抱): hold and look after a sick person.
Untie (解) + cut open (剖): cut a body open to study it.
Coming (来) from outside (外): imported, or a hospital's outpatient clinic.
Go around (回) + look (覧): a paper passed around for everyone to read.
General (概) + shortened (略): a short outline, the gist.
Sea (海) flow (流): an ocean current.
Change (改) to good (良): improve.
Go around (回) + road (路): the round path electricity takes, a circuit.
Sea (海) road (路): a sea route.
省 means reflect on yourself (like 反省): look back at your own actions.
顧 has the head part (頁): turn your head to look back.
Face (顔) + attached (付き): the look attached to your face, an expression.
Outside (外) the lessons (課): extracurricular.
掲 means put up high (like 掲示, notice): raise a flag or sign high.
Write (書き) + take (取る): take down words by writing.
Scratch or stir (掻き) + turn around (回す): stir something round and round.
Learning (学) + arts (芸): arts and sciences.
Rank (格) + difference (差): the gap between levels, disparity.
Spread wide (拡) + scatter (散): spreading out everywhere, diffusion.
Learning (学) + scholar (士): someone with a university degree.
Each (各) kind (種): every kind, all sorts.
Gap (隔) + week (週): leave a week's gap, every other week.
Reform (革) + new (新): making things new, innovation.
Learning (学) + theory (説): a scholar's theory.
Certain (確) + fixed (定): decided for sure.
Catch (獲) + gain (得): win or acquire something.
Music (楽) + written record (譜): sheet music.
Change (革) heaven's order (命): overthrow the ruler, a revolution.
Certain (確) + stand (立): make something stand firmly, establish.
Mountain (山) over a cliff edge (厓): a cliff.
Gallop (駆け) + feet (足): running fast.
Run (駆け) + っこ (kids' game): a running race.
Add (加) work (工): work on raw material, processing.
Change (化) + combine (合): two substances join and become a new one.
Items (箇) + clauses (条) + writing (書): writing things as a list of points.
霞 has rain (雨) on top: misty air, things look hazy.
Fire (火) star (星): the red planet, Mars.
Changed (化) into stone (石): a fossil.
River (河) + river (川): rivers in general.
Chemical (化) fiber (繊): synthetic fibers.
Too (過) sparse (疎): too few people, depopulation.
Pieces (片) of words (言): speaking a language in broken little bits.
Hard (固): make something hard and solid.
Flower (花) + raised platform (壇): a flower bed.
House (家) + raise animals (畜): animals kept at home, livestock.
且 means moreover: and also, yet.
Fit (合) + bring to (致): match exactly, agree.
Lively (活) + burst out (発): active and full of energy.
Mouth (口) + ten (十): say your wish ten times and it comes true.
Same 叶 as 叶う (come true): to make a wish come true for someone.
Metal (金) hammer (槌): a hammer. It sinks, so it also means a non swimmer.
Add (加) + enter (入): join a group as a member.
予 means beforehand: something already known or planned, previously.
庇 means eaves: stand over someone like a roof and protect them.
Tree stump or share (株) + form (式): company shares, stock.
Money (貨) + coin (幣): money, currency.
Build (構): build your stance, get ready, set up.
Too (過) dense (密): overcrowded.
Bite (噛み) + cut (切る): bite right through something.
Body (体) + attached (付き): the shape of your body, your build.
Thread (糸) part: threads wrapping around something, to entangle.
Too much (過) labor (労): overwork.
Cross (交): words cross between people, to exchange.
Replace (代), replace (代): take turns, alternately.
Simple (簡) + easy (易): a simple, quick version.
Both have water (氵): pour (灌) water on fields (漑), irrigation.
Eye (眼) department (科): the eye clinic.
Eye (眼) ball (球): eyeball.
Play with (玩) + tool (具): a toy.
Simple (簡) + clean (潔): short and clear.
Return (還) to the origin (元): give back, or reduce in chemistry.
Chinese (漢) words (語): words that came from Chinese.
Urge (勧) + tell (告): official advice.
Exchange (換) + calculate (算): convert units or money.
Oversee (監) + look (視): watch closely, surveillance.
Watching (観) crowd (衆): spectators.
Request (願) + document (書): an application form.
Interfere (干) + get involved (渉): butting into other people's business.
Stubborn (頑) + strong man (丈): solid and tough.
Liver (肝) + kidney (腎): two vital organs, so essential.
Checkpoint (関) + tax (税): tax paid at the border, customs duty.
Rock (岩) + stone (石): rock.
Feel (感) + dye (染): a disease soaks into you, infection.
View (観) + point (点): point of view.
Feel (感) + degree (度): how strongly something senses, sensitivity.
Origin (元) year (年): the first year of an era.
Tree trunk (幹) + section (部): the trunk of a company, the executives.
Complete (完) + jade disc (璧): a flawless jade disc, perfect.
Think over (勘) + judge (弁): think it over and let it go, pardon.
Feeling (感) without (無) measure (量): too much emotion to measure.
Urge (勧) + lure (誘): ask people to join, canvassing.
Connect (関) + give (与): be connected to it, take part.
Wide (寛) + accept (容): accepting widely, tolerant.
From the origin (元) coming (来): originally.
Watch (観) + look (覧): viewing a show or exhibit.
Habit (慣) + example (例): a custom, precedent.
Return (還) + calendar (暦): the 60 year calendar cycle comes back, your 60th birthday.
Old weight unit (貫) + samurai pay (禄): the heavy presence of an important person, dignity.
Loosen (緩) + soften (和): easing, relief.
Debate (議) + proposal (案): a bill for discussion.
Rule (規) + standard (格): a standard size or norm.
Wear (着) + decorate (飾る): dress up.
Mind (気) + hesitate (兼ね): worrying about others, so you hold back.
Hear (聞き) + take (取り): catch what you hear, listening.
Work well (効き) + point (目): how well it works, the effect.
Return (帰) to the capital (京): go back to Tokyo.
Play (戯) + piece (曲): the script of a stage play.
Base (基) money (金): a fund.
Joy (喜) + drama (劇): comedy.
Debate (議) + decide (決): decide by vote.
Throw away (棄) your right (権): abstain.
Already (既) married (婚): married.
From 気に障る (gets on your nerves): a showy, annoying manner, affected.
兆 shows cracks on a fortune bone: a sign or omen.
Spirit (気) + nature (質): temperament.
Set period (期) + day (日): a fixed date.
Discussion (議) matters (事) hall (堂): the Diet building.
Write down (記) + state (述): describe in writing.
Wound (傷) + attach (付く): a wound sticks to you, you get hurt.
Wound (傷) + attach (付ける): put a wound on someone, hurt them.
Steam (汽) ship (船): steamship.
Send (寄) + present (贈): give as a gift, donate.
Fake (偽) + make (造): forgery.
Noble (貴) clan (族): aristocrats.
Debate (議) + topic (題): an agenda item.
How your spirit (気) stands (立て): your nature, kind hearted.
几帳 is a curtain stand with carefully finished edges (面): neat, careful, methodical.
Start (起) point (点): starting point.
Wheel track (軌) + road (道): an orbit or rail track.
Rule (規) + model (範): a standard to follow.
Spirit (気) + grace (品): elegance.
Spirit (気) + style (風): the character of a group or place.
Rise (起) and lie down (伏): land going up and down.
Mind (気) + まぐれ (fluke): moods change by chance, a whim.
Pure (生) + serious (真面目): very serious, too earnest.
Write (記) name (名): sign your name.
Rule (規) + promise (約): the rules of an agreement.
脚 as in 脚本 (script) + color (色): coloring a story into a script, dramatization.
Leg (脚) + book (本): the book a play stands on, the script.
Showy (華) + luxury (奢): fine and delicate like luxury goods, slender.
Guest's (客) view (観): seeing as an outsider, objective.
Rescue (救) + aid (援): relief, rescue.
Rest (休) from school (学): taking time off school.
Study deeply (究) to the extreme (極): ultimate.
Ball (球) + root (根): a round root, a bulb.
Rescue (救) + relieve (済): help people in trouble.
Supply (給) + serve (仕): someone who serves food, a waiter.
Rest (休) from battle (戦): a truce.
Palace (宮) + hall (殿): a palace.
Old (旧) + know (知): someone you have known a long time.
Extreme need (窮) + lack (乏): poverty.
